title: Q-SELFIMPROVE-SENSE: sensing adapters and weekly driver for SELF-IMPROVE-1
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:foundation/selfimprove.py::def sense
**Status:** closed

SELF-IMPROVE-1 (doctrine/self-improvement.json) has the ranker and verdict rule. Build `sense(root)` in foundation/selfimprove.py: one reader per signal row that turns its source into a value, then a weekly `--run` that ranks, picks one lever, writes ev=predict to ops/improvements.jsonl and queues a Q-IMPROVE item; after window_days it writes ev=verdict via verdict() and files OL-REVERT on a breach. Register the run as a loop in instances/ultrastable/loop-registry.json so it is scored by lifecycle.improve (the improver improves itself).

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 175.2 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
